不录就和强拍用同一个声音: If you skip it, the downbeat sound is used
到点时先提醒，再停止节拍器: Remind first at the goal, then stop the metronome
同一组随机结果可以重复练: The same random pattern can be practiced again
对着麦克风发出一下短促的声音，比如拍手、说“嗒”、敲桌子。每段最长 2 秒，开头: Make one short sound into the microphone, like a clap, a “tick” or a knock on the table. Up to 2 seconds each; silence at the start is trimmed and the volume is evened out automatically.
已暂停节拍器，避免麦克风收进节拍声: Metronome paused so the microphone doesn't pick up the clicks
弦（点按锁定，再点解锁）: String (tap to lock, tap again to unlock)
强拍重、弱拍轻，和声音同步: Strong beats heavy, weak beats light, synced with sound
按当天累计的练习时间算: Based on your total practice time for the day
按节奏连续点按来设定速度: Tap repeatedly in rhythm to set the tempo
数字是弦号，5 代表根音弦（当前和弦是 %lld 弦）: Numbers are string numbers; 5 stands for the root string (this chord: string %lld)
每小节拍数 / 以几分音符为一拍: Beats per bar / note value of one beat
每小节第一拍总是响: The first beat of every bar always sounds
没有录到声音，请靠近麦克风再录一次: No sound was recorded. Move closer to the microphone and try again.
没有麦克风权限。请到系统设置里允许本 App 使用麦克风。: No microphone access. Allow this app to use the microphone in Settings.
点一下试听，强 · 次强 · 弱各一个音: Tap to preview. Strong, medium and weak each have their own sound
点按方块切换重音：强 · 次强 · 弱 · 静音: Tap a box to change accent: strong · medium · weak · mute
目标 %@，到时提醒并停止: Goal %@, remind and stop when reached
目标比起始低就是渐进减速: A target lower than the start makes a gradual slow-down
调准一根弦时播放“叮咚”提示音: Play a “ding-dong” when a string is in tune
还没有练习记录。播放 30 秒以上会自动记一次。: No practice sessions yet. Playing for over 30 seconds is logged automatically.
随机静音 %@ 的拍 · 保留首拍: Randomly mute %@ of beats · keep downbeat
需要麦克风权限才能调音: Microphone access is needed to tune
静音时保持心里的节拍，恢复时检查有没有跑快或跑慢: Keep the beat in your head while muted, then check whether you sped up or slowed down when it returns
±60 毫秒内算准，±120 毫秒内算偏，再远算漏；多出来的一下扣半格。: Within ±60 ms is Good, within ±120 ms is Off, anything farther is Missed. Each extra strum costs half a slot.
不错，继续保持手腕匀速摆动，空拍也别停。: Nice. Keep your wrist swinging steadily, even through the silent beats.
先听示范，再跟着练；戴耳机可以听着节拍练。: Listen to the demo, then play along. Wear headphones to hear the click while you practice.
准备，跟着倒数和高亮（外放时不放节拍声）: Get ready: follow the count-in and highlights (no click through the speaker)
准备，跟着耳机里的节拍: Get ready: follow the click in your headphones
多扫了 %lld 下，注意空拍时手要继续摆动但不碰弦。: %lld extra strums. On the silent beats, keep your hand moving without touching the strings.
已校准：以后跟练会扣掉 %lld 毫秒的延迟。: Calibrated: %lld ms of latency will be subtracted from now on.
很多下没有收到声音：把手机放近一点，扫得干脆一些，或者先在安静的地方练。: Many strums weren’t picked up. Move the phone closer, strum more crisply, or practice somewhere quiet first.
很稳！可以把速度加 5 BPM 再试试。: Very steady! Try it again 5 BPM faster.
快慢不太稳（偏差约 ±%lld 毫秒），先把速度调慢 10 BPM 练熟。: Your timing is uneven (off by about ±%lld ms). Slow down by 10 BPM until it feels solid.
整体平均快了 %lld 毫秒，有点抢拍，跟着高亮再稳一点。: On average you’re %lld ms ahead of the beat. Follow the highlight and settle in a bit.
整体平均慢了 %lld 毫秒，试着提前一点点下手。: On average you’re %lld ms behind the beat. Try striking a touch earlier.
没收到足够的声音（%lld/8），请靠近手机、跟着每一拍扫一下再试一次。: Not enough sound picked up (%lld/8). Move closer to the phone, strum on every beat, and try again.
第一版只看扫弦的时间准不准，不判断你实际是上扫还是下扫；箭头是节奏型里该用的扫法: For now, only the timing of your strums is checked, not whether you actually played an upstroke or a downstroke. The arrows show the stroke the pattern calls for.
该上扫的那几下平均比下扫快 %lld 毫秒，上扫别急，等到“&”再扫。: Your upstrokes land %lld ms ahead of your downstrokes on average. Don’t rush them; wait for the “&”.
该上扫的那几下平均比下扫慢 %lld 毫秒，回扫时手腕放松、别停顿。: Your upstrokes land %lld ms behind your downstrokes on average. Keep your wrist loose on the way back and don’t pause.
需要麦克风权限才能听你扫弦：请到系统设置里允许“调音节拍和弦库”使用麦克风。: TuneBeatChord needs microphone access to hear your strumming. Go to Settings and allow it to use the microphone.
麦克风收到声音会晚一点。倒数之后，跟着屏幕上的节拍（戴耳机时听节拍声）每一拍扫一: The microphone hears sound slightly late. After the count-in, follow the beats on screen (or the click in your headphones) and strum or tap the body of your instrument on every beat, 8 beats in all.
格数要是 %lld 的整数倍: The number of cells must be a multiple of %lld
同名的会被覆盖。: A progression with the same name will be replaced.
换到 %@ 时普遍晚了 %lld 毫秒，可以提前准备按法。: When changing to %@ you were %lld ms late on average — get the fingering ready earlier.
换和弦后的第一下常常没扫到，换把时右手别停，先扫空弦也可以。: The first strum after a chord change is often missed. Keep your strumming hand moving as you change — even strumming open strings is fine.
换和弦后的第一下平均比其他时候晚 %lld 毫秒，在上一小节最后一拍就开始换把。: The first strum after a chord change is on average %lld ms later than the rest. Start changing on the last beat of the previous bar.
换和弦后第一下：刚好: First strum after chord change: on time
换和弦后第一下：平均偏快 %lld 毫秒: First strum after chord change: %lld ms early on average
换和弦后第一下：平均偏慢 %lld 毫秒: First strum after chord change: %lld ms late on average
点按修改，长按拖动排序: Tap to edit, touch and hold to reorder
还没有保存的进行。编辑好和弦后点“保存”。: No saved progressions yet. Edit your chords, then tap “Save”.
用 D（下扫）U（上扫）X（闷音）·（空拍）写出自己的节奏型，和弦库里也能用: Write your own rhythm with D (down), U (up), X (mute) and · (rest) – it works in the chord library too
跟着节奏扫，麦克风帮你打分: Strum along – the mic scores your timing
还没练过，先听一听再开始: Not practiced yet – listen first, then start
“%@”最近 3 次都在 90 分以上。: Your last 3 scores on “%@” were all 90 or higher.
示范中：一直循环，点“停止”结束: Demo is looping – tap “Stop” to end
还没有收藏的节奏型：点星标收藏。: No favorite rhythms yet – tap the star to add one.
还没有收藏的节奏型：长按节奏型或点格子上方的星标收藏。: No favorite rhythms yet – long-press a rhythm or tap the star above the grid.
这件乐器的节奏型都已掌握。: You’ve mastered every rhythm for this instrument.
输入弦号，1 弦最细（最多 %lld 弦）。- 或 0 是空拍（不弹，占一个音的: Enter string numbers, 1 = thinnest (up to %lld). - or 0 is a rest (silent, takes one note's time); separate with spaces or commas, or write them together; R means the chord's root string.
只能输入 1–%lld 的弦号、0 或 -（空拍）和字母 R: Only string numbers 1–%lld, 0 or - (rest) and the letter R are allowed
每个字符一格：B 根音、D 全扫、d 半扫、U 上扫、X 闷音、- 或 . 空拍: One character per cell: B root, D full strum, d half strum, U up, X muted, - or . rest (D and d are case-sensitive). Spaces only group cells.
Only B, D, d, U, X, - and . are allowed
B 只拨根音弦；D 从根音弦扫到 1 弦；d 和 U 只扫高音的 3–4 根弦。: B plays only the root string; D strums from the root string to string 1; d and U strum only the 3–4 treble strings.
